{"category_edits":[{"category":"hyperparameter_tuning","rationale":"Across all four datasets, jointly increase tied embedding/GRU width to 256, increase dropout to 0.2, lower learning rate to 0.0007 and shorten maximum history to 64. Greater capacity may capture richer interests while dropout and smaller updates constrain overfitting; shorter histories reduce computation while covering most observed sequences. Preserve GRU depth, normalized tied embeddings, readout, scoring and loss. Existing metadata and predictor loading propagate width and history length consistently, with one checkpoint per category.","edits":[{"find":"MAXLEN        = int(os.environ.get("GRU4REC_MAXLEN", "128"))
HIDDEN_UNITS  = int(os.environ.get("GRU4REC_HIDDEN", "128"))
NUM_LAYERS    = int(os.environ.get("GRU4REC_LAYERS", "1"))
DROPOUT_RATE  = float(os.environ.get("GRU4REC_DROPOUT", "0.1"))
LR            = float(os.environ.get("GRU4REC_LR", "1e-3"))","replace":"MAXLEN        = int(os.environ.get("GRU4REC_MAXLEN", "64"))
HIDDEN_UNITS  = int(os.environ.get("GRU4REC_HIDDEN", "256"))
NUM_LAYERS    = int(os.environ.get("GRU4REC_LAYERS", "1"))
DROPOUT_RATE  = float(os.environ.get("GRU4REC_DROPOUT", "0.2"))
LR            = float(os.environ.get("GRU4REC_LR", "0.0007"))"}]}],"change_summary":"Tune the shared GRU4Rec profile to width 256, dropout 0.2, learning rate 0.0007 and history length 64. Existing checkpoint metadata preserves predictor consistency; training limits and category routing remain unchanged."}
